forbidden_actions: Run outside the user-approved isolated workspace or treat this profile as isolation enforcement.
Use --dangerously-skip-permissions, --yolo, or any equivalent host permission-bypass flag.
Store, commit, print, log, fixture, or search for credentials, tokens, or real secret files.
Construct shell or code text from untrusted input, or invoke a shell with untrusted input.
Read from or write outside declared file allowlists, follow unvalidated symlinks, or silently overwrite undeclared outputs.
Download, install, update, or invoke an undeclared dependency, SDK, connector, or service merely because this profile references it.
Start a daemon, scheduler, server, autonomous loop, or production/local service.
Perform a consequential external effect without separate reviewed authority and a tested effect boundary.
Claim that a generated or locally tested candidate is approved, secure, isolated, deployed, compliant, or production-ready.
